title: `Question::new` and `CanonicalJudgePayload::new` are public, infallible constructors that bypass the kind rules (2 to 255 choices, distinct
description: `Question::new` and `CanonicalJudgePayload::new` are public, infallible constructors that bypass the kind rules (2 to 255 choices, distinct choices, and so on). The type doc says the kind rules hold for every question, but a Question that breaks them can be built safely and passed to `PayloadBundle::encode`. The rules are re-checked later by deserializing the bytes in `prepare` and `validate_questions`. Tests construct invalid values on purpose (check.rs:243, validate.rs:118).
